why_choose_us.title: We never subcontract
why_choose_us.description: Every installer on your roof is on MNM's payroll and was trained by Miguel himself. The company that quotes the job is the company that does it.

why_choose_us.title: 10-year workmanship warranty
why_choose_us.description: Every full roof replacement carries a 10-year workmanship warranty on top of the manufacturer's material coverage, plus our 15-year craftsman warranty.

why_choose_us.title: Three offices across NEPA
why_choose_us.description: Greentown for the Poconos, Nanticoke for Luzerne County, and Whitehall Township for the Lehigh Valley. We are local wherever you are.

why_choose_us.title: A showroom you can walk into
why_choose_us.description: Premium shingles, metal panel profiles, gutter systems and colour samples on display in Greentown — see and feel the materials before you decide.

financing.headline: Financing for your roof
financing.description: A roof is rarely a purchase you planned for. We work with outside lending partners so you can spread the cost — applications take under ten minutes and come back with a decision right away. Ask about it when we come out for your estimate.

services_section.subtitle: Shingle, metal and rubber systems, storm repairs and seamless gutters — installed from our three Northeast Pennsylvania offices by our own in-house crews.

closing_cta.headline: Ready for a roof that was done right the first time?
closing_cta.body: Estimates are free and Miguel, the owner, oversees every one of them himself. We have been roofing Northeast Pennsylvania since 2018 from offices in Greentown, Nanticoke and Whitehall Township — and we have never once handed a job to a subcontractor.
